parsed.restated: ∃ (G : Type) (_ : Group G), Group.IsFinitelyPresented G ∧ ∃ (F : Finset G) (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε ∧ ε < 1 ∧ ∀ M : SoficGroups.PermutationModel G, ¬ SoficGroups.GoodOn M F ε
parsed.proof:
constructor
· rintro ⟨G, inst, hfp, hns⟩
  refine ⟨G, inst, hfp, ?_⟩
  by_contra h
  push_neg at h
  exact hns ⟨fun F ε h0 h1 => h F ε h0 h1⟩
· rintro ⟨G, inst, hfp, F, ε, h0, h1, h⟩
  refine ⟨G, inst, hfp, ?_⟩
  rintro ⟨hs⟩
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := hs F ε h0 h1
  exact h M hM
parsed.english: There is a finitely presented group G and a finite subset F of G and an ε strictly between 0 and 1 such that no permutation model on a finite set Fin n is ε-good on F, meaning almost multiplicative on F and sending non-identity elements of F to permutations far from the identity, with both conditions in normalized Hamming distance.
parsed.why_clearer: It unfolds the `Sofic` class into an explicit failure of the finite-permutation approximation property for a specific finite set F and tolerance ε, so no typeclass needs to be unpacked.
